bibl.title: Bulletin of Online Emendations to Papyri (BOEP) 11 (October 23, 2023)
bibl.seg: Rodney Ast, Lajos Berkes, James M.S. Cowey, Holger Essler & Julia Lougovaya, Bulletin of Online Emendations to Papyri (BOEP) 11 (October 12, 2023).
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 4 (2023) §1-4, fig.
bibl.note: This installment reports all of the emendation proposals to Greek, Latin and Coptic documentary and literary texts that were accepted to either the Duke Databank of Documentary Papyri or the Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri via the Papyrological Editor (PE) between November 2, 2022 and October 12, 2023. The new readings [by M.J. Albarrán Martínez, C. Balamoshev, L. Berkes, A. Boud'hors, W.G. Claytor, A. de Frutos García, M.G. Elmaghrabi, H. Essler, N. Gonis, D. Hagedorn, M. Hartwig, W.B. Henry, T. Hickey, S. Kovarik, B. Laudenbach, T. Laver, N. Litinas, J. Lougovaya, G. Papaioannou, S. Rahyab, N. Reggiani, F. Reiter, S. Remijsen, C.M. Sampson, A. Skalec, A. Sonina, M. Stern, L. Vanderheyden, P. van der Laan, M. Vierros, & L. Weisser-Gericke] have been vetted by members of the PE's editorial board.
